case.title: Participant submission lasting exactly 180 s does not fire

submissions.open_text: We walk to the lake shore at dawn because the nearby stream dried up.
Queues at the communal point are shorter since a second spout opened.

case.why: The participant minimum is 3 minutes = 180 s and the rule is strictly below. eva lasts exactly 180 s, so too_fast must not fire. Using <= would wrongly fire. So would applying the 720 s enumerator minimum to a participant. Other checks are quiet: same_spot never fires for participants, and burst needs 5. Both points are inside Nyalenda (lng 34.74-34.76, lat -0.11 to -0.09). The times are 08:30 and 17:10 local on different days. The texts are distinct. There is no voice note, and the device is used only by P02.
